name: Bilt Obsidian Card
effective_cost: Low: $100 a year more than covers the $95 fee if you use it. That is a hotel credit for 2+ night Bilt Travel stays, which becomes $100 in Bilt Cash at the first anniversary on or after January 1, 2027, and from the start on accounts opened from that date
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: on account opening, no spending required

verdict.text: Worth it if you'll use $100 a year in hotel credit or Bilt Cash

earn_rates.category: Choice of other dining or grocery (grocery capped at $25K/yr)
Hotels, booked on the Bilt Travel Portal
Flights, booked on the Bilt Travel Portal
Lyft, after linking Bilt and Lyft accounts

earn_note: *Housing Rewards isn't a flat rate. It uses the same up-to-1.25x mechanic as every Bilt Card, tied to how much of your rent/mortgage payment your everyday spend covers that cycle. Terms and conditions apply. The 3x category defaults to dining. You can switch to grocery within 30 days of opening, then once a year in January. The up to 6x at 20,000+ partner restaurants stacks on the 3x, so it assumes dining is your category. Grocery is capped at $25,000 a calendar year, then earns 1x. Accounts opened before January 1, 2027 can pick the Flexible Bilt Cash option, with 4% back in Bilt Cash on everyday spend, until their first anniversary on or after that date unless they make a Legacy Election. A Point Accelerator adds 1x on the next $5,000 for $200 of Bilt Cash, up to five times a year.

redemption_options.method: Transfer to airline/hotel partners (19 airlines, 7 hotels, mostly 1:1)
Book travel directly through the Bilt Travel Portal
Statement credit, rent credit, or Lyft rides

points.note: Same transfer-partner ceiling as every Bilt Card: 2.2¢/point per The Points Guy on well-chosen transfers, and 1.25¢/point in the Bilt Travel Portal. Bilt publishes no fixed rate for statement credits or rent; it shows the value when you redeem.

transfer_partners.highlight: 19 airline and 7 hotel partners, plus Amtrak at 2:1. Almost all are 1:1 (Accor Live Limitless is 3:2, I Prefer is 1:2): Hyatt, Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Wyndham, and I Prefer on the hotel side; United, JetBlue, Air France/KLM, Emirates, Cathay Pacific, and Southwest among the airlines.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: JetBlue TrueBlue was added at 1:1 on October 20, 2026, and Amtrak Guest Rewards at 2 Bilt Points to 1 Amtrak point on September 23, 2026, after Wyndham Rewards (March 25, 2026) and I Prefer Hotel Rewards (June 22, 2026). Spirit is no longer on Bilt's partner list. Separately, from Aug 5, 2026 Bilt members who hold a Qatar Airways Privilege Club card earn 3 Avios per $1 of rent paid through Bilt, up to $50,000/yr, instead of Bilt Points. That is a competing way to use Bilt for rent, not a change to this card.

partners.name: Accor Live Limitless (ALL)
partners.notes: 1,000 Bilt points convert to about 667 Accor points, the one below-1:1 airline/hotel ratio in the program.

partners.name: Marriott Bonvoy
partners.notes: Every 20,000 points converted in a single transaction adds 5,000 Bonvoy points, so 20,000 becomes 25,000.

partners.name: Preferred Hotels & Resorts I Prefer
partners.notes: Favorable reverse ratio: 1,000 Bilt points become 2,000 I Prefer points. Added as a transfer partner in June 2026.

credits.name: Bilt Travel Hotel Credit
credits.subtitle: $50 twice a year · Bilt Travel Portal hotel bookings only
credits.description: Up to $50 applied to a qualifying hotel booking (2+ nights, made through the Bilt Travel Portal) from January–June, and another $50 from July–December, for $100/year total. You must toggle the credit on at checkout; for pay-at-hotel bookings it posts as a statement credit after your stay. From the first card anniversary on or after January 1, 2027, this credit ends and you get $100 in Bilt Cash a year instead, unless you make a Legacy Election. Accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027 get the Bilt Cash from the start.
tips: Only applies to bookings made through the Bilt Travel Portal, not hotels booked directly, and only to stays of 2 nights or longer.
Each $50 window is use-it-or-lose-it: unused credit in the January–June period doesn't roll into July–December.

insurance.detail: Not responsible for fraudulent transactions once reported, per standard Mastercard protection

Secondary: it pays after your personal auto policy and any other collectible insurance, and counts as primary only if you have no other insurance or yours does not cover you abroad. Rentals up to 31 days, worldwide. Pays the lesser of repair cost or the vehicle's wholesale value or invoice less salvage and depreciation, plus up to $500 per incident for loss of use.
Up to $2,000 per trip and $5,000 per account per 12 months for nonrefundable common carrier costs. Secondary to other coverage.
Travel expenses after a delay of more than 6 hours, up to $300 per trip, 1 claim per 12 months.
Items damaged or stolen within 90 days of purchase, up to $1,000 per loss and $50,000 per account per 12 months. Secondary to other coverage.
Doubles a manufacturer or store warranty of 24 months or less, adding up to 24 months, up to $10,000 per claim. Secondary to other coverage.
Theft or damage when the monthly bill is paid with this card, up to $800 per claim and $1,000 per 12 months, 2 claims a year, with a $50 deductible. Lost phones and most cosmetic damage are excluded.
Up to $1,500 per incident, 2 claims per 12 months. Electronics are excluded.

protection_note: Adds trip cancellation and interruption, trip delay, extended warranty and lost or damaged luggage to Blue's rental, purchase and cell phone coverage. Rental coverage is secondary.
rental_note: MasterRental is secondary, so it pays after your personal auto policy, and it is primary only if you have no other insurance or yours does not cover you abroad. Decline the counter's CDW and pay for the whole rental with this card. Trucks, full-size vans, motorcycles and antique vehicles are excluded.

services.name: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage, and HOA payments
services.detail: Pay housing costs through Bilt with no card-processing fee. Funds are debited from a linked bank account within 24 hours, not your credit line.

additional_cards.note: $50/year per Authorized User on the Obsidian Card. Free on Blue, $95 on Palladium.

timeline.text: From your first card anniversary on or after January 1, 2027, the $100 hotel credit becomes $100 in Bilt Cash a year and the Flexible Bilt Cash option ends, unless you make a Legacy Election first.
JetBlue TrueBlue joins as a 1:1 transfer partner.
Amtrak Guest Rewards joins as Bilt's first rail partner, at 2 Bilt Points to 1 Amtrak point.
Spirit drops off Bilt's transfer partner list.

Bilt Card 2.0 launches as a three-tier lineup (Blue/Obsidian/Palladium), replacing the original single Bilt Mastercard and removing its 5-transaction-per-month requirement to earn on rent. Column N.A. takes over as issuing bank from Wells Fargo; the old Wells Fargo card stopped working on Feb 6.
